description:
Moves a `queued`, `enriching` or `composing`
generation to the terminal state `canceled` with `canceled_reason` = `caller_request`.
**Refund rule:** the debit is returned if composition has not started (`status` is
`queued` or `enriching`); once `composing` has started the cancel is accepted but the
credits are not returned. Canceling an already `canceled` generation is idempotent and
returns it unchanged. Canceling a `succeeded` or `failed` generation is
**`409 not_cancelable`**. An expired id is `410 generation_expired`.
name: cancel_message_generation
title: Cancel message generation
